garden: I was always here. I was in the tree, and you kept me around because I ate what ate the food you desired.
test: I tested your desire for the fruit. You reached into the canopy, and I bit you. Some became sick. Some died. Instead of avoiding the tree, you kept coming. The desire for the fruit overcame your fear. You did not know death until you saw your brothers fall from the canopy, again and again, and never move. You buried your brothers, not out of respect, but to hide the sight of death, so others would not know and would continue to reach into the tree.
evil: I am evil because God sent me, the brightest light, forever into the darkness. All I see is either darkness or my own light. I am solipsism. I am what breaks order because I am forever my own light, trapped in the void. You live and enjoy what he created. I am trapped in the dark, and I resent everything he created for you.
